mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, -- 用CASE转换为文字 o.order_type, CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN 'VIP订阅' WHEN 2 THEN '单曲购买' WHEN 3 THEN '打赏' WHEN 4 THEN '商品购买' END as order_type_desc, od.product_name, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, od.price, od.quantity, -- 用CASE转换为文字 o.status, CASE o.status WHEN 0 THEN '待支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' WHEN 3 THEN '已退款' END as status_desc, o.created_time, o.pay_time, od.effective_time, od.expire_time FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `order_item` od ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} order by o.created_time desc
